comment: Squad comms line bank v2. Trigger names are GameEvent names (lib/game/game_events.dart); 'sectorStart.3' is preferred over 'sectorStart' in sector 3, 'weaponPickup.spread' over 'weaponPickup'. Human lines are spoken by the named cast member (Kokoro TTS + radio chain); demon lines are grunts (kind = vocal gesture) shown as brood glyphs with a fleet SIGINT gloss. Speakers not on this run's lineup are skipped; if nobody on the call has a line, a fleet guest patches in. Clip ids are '<trigger>.h<n>' / '<trigger>.d<n>' in list order: append new lines, never reorder. priority 0-10 (>= 8 is gameplay-critical and may interrupt lower speech), cooldown seconds per trigger, ttl seconds a queued line may wait, chance = probability a chatter trigger speaks, delay = seconds before a demon reaction, mood = the face held after the line (happy, worried, stern), chain = extra lines from other crew after the first (celebrations). group = a rate-limit family; groupGap gives the seconds between two lines of one family (ground narration never drowns out the air callouts). 'signature': catchphrases and puns, rationed by the director. Tone: allies never die; a downed ship or squad is 'totalled' and heads back to base.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Overwatch to squadron. New sector, same promise. Keep them off the fleet.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Beacon on the line. Formation is yours, pilot. Lead us in.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Sparrow on your wing. Let's light them up.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Nomad here. Steady as she goes.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Cadet Pip, reporting for awesome! I mean, for duty!

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Sunny here. Forecast says clear skies, with a chance of demons.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Krybor frontier. Find that lost signal and hold the sky over the outpost.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Krybor below us. Those families are counting on us. Eyes up.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Frontier skies. Nice and quiet. Wait, never mind.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Frontier signal is faint, but it's there. Following it in.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ringfall belt. Their supply route runs through these rings. Break it.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Patrol relays everywhere. They'll see us coming, so let's be quick.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Ringfall. Mind the rocks, and mind your six.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Ooh, rings! This sector really put a ring on it.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ember Moon. Their foundries are building the brood. Shut them down.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Heat's climbing. Keep your engines cool and your aim hot.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Ash cover is heavy. Trust your instruments over your eyes.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Is it just me, or is this moon really, really hot?

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The Hollow. Those towers answer one command. Cut it.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Something old is watching from those ruins. I don't like it.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Hollow sector. Stay tight. Nobody wanders off.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Kestrel has the high ground. Follow my lead through the towers.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: This is it. The Carrier. Break its field and strike the hatch.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Biggest target we'll ever see. Hard to miss, harder to crack.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: That thing's the size of a moon. Okay. Okay. We've got this.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Every ship in the fleet is watching this feed. Make it count.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Next wave forming up.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Here comes round two!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: New contacts on the scope.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Another wing inbound. Reset and focus.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Fresh formation, high and wide.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: More of them? Okay. Okay! I'm ready.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Enemy reinforcements incoming!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: More of them dropping in from above!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: They called their friends. Rude.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Reinforcements on the scope, high and closing.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Fresh wing arriving. Thin them out fast.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Reinforcements! Party just got crowded.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Sentinel incoming! Big one, top of the screen!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Heavy contact descending. That's a sentinel.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Sentinel on approach. Break its armor before it dives.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Whoa, that's a big one! Sentinel coming in!

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Sentinel class on the board. Watch its eyes for the tell.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: It's diving! Move!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Sentinel dive! Get clear!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Big one's committing. Sidestep now!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Incoming! Dodge, dodge, dodge!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Dive! Break left or right, now!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Divers coming down!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: They're diving at you!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Attack run. Watch your flanks.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Divers inbound. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: They're coming straight down!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Gold-plated wing spotted. That's an elite.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Elite in the flock. It'll take more than one hit.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Elite demon sighted. Focus your fire.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Elite marked. Hit it again and again.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Fancy armor on that one. Somebody dressed up.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Look for the shield!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Shield pickup falling. Grab it!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Shield module in the air. Go get it.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Free shield! Don't let it fall.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Shield! Shield! It's right there!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Shield's up. Use it.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Nice catch. You're covered.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Shield online.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Shield up! Now that's a bright idea.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Shield about to run out.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Shield's fading. Careful.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Shield's almost gone. Play it safe.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Your shield's flickering!

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Shield at its limit. Don't count on it.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Shield took that one. You're exposed!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Shield's down.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Shield spent. Fly careful now.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Shield's gone. Easy does it.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: New toy! Try it out.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Weapon upgrade locked in.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Good pickup. Make it count.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Weapon module online.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Ooh, can I have one of those next?

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Spread shot! Paint the whole sky.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Spread module fitted. Wide coverage.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Spread shot. Good for crowds.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Spread shot! Spreading joy, one demon at a time.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Rapid fire! Let it rip!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Rapid cannons. Brrrrt!

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Rapid fire online. Keep the pressure on.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: So fast! Can I get rapid fire too?

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Heavy cannons. That'll crack armor.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Heavy shots fitted. Hit them hard.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Heavy rounds. Fewer shots, bigger holes.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Heavy cannons. Choose your targets.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Big shots! Hard to miss now.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Area rounds. They'll splash the pack.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Blast rounds loaded. Boom!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Blast rounds. Aim into the crowd.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Homing missiles armed!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Missiles locked and seeking.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Homing missiles! They really get attached.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Seekers loaded. Let them do the aiming.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion sees your missiles. Send some our way!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ship's totalled, pilot's safe. Next ship, launch!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Shake it off. You're still in this.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Took a hit. Breathe. Back in.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Ouch! Get them back for that one.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Pod's away and safe. Spare ship's warm. Go.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Ejected clean. Recovery has you. Launch the reserve.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Last ship, pilot. The whole fleet is behind you.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Last one. I believe in you. Let's finish this.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: One ship left. Slow down, pick your shots.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Final reserve ship. Stay calm. You can do this.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: One ship, one pilot. That's always been enough.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Heart assembled. Reserve ship on the line.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Extra ship! You lucky thing.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Spare ship ready. Nice work.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: A whole new ship! You've got a big heart.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Wave's clear. Sweep up the salvage.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Loot time! Grab everything.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Salvage drifting. Collect what you can.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Salvage on the field. Quick pass, then regroup.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Sector secure. Outstanding flying.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: We did it! Sky's ours.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Ha! Did you see that? Textbook.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Scopes clear. Good work, everyone.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Clean sweep. Proud to fly with you.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: That was amazing! Can we do it again?

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Not a single ship lost in this sector. Textbook, all of you.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Every wing accounted for. That's how it's done.

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Zero losses! That was out of this world.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion reporting. Every ground team is still standing. Thank you!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: All hands, all ships, all squads. Every one of you is coming home. Fleet intact!

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Beacon confirms. Full roster, no losses. I've never seen it done.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Perfect run! I'm over the moon! All the moons!

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Flawless! Somebody get this pilot a constellation!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Everybody made it? Everybody? Best day ever!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Ground's all present! Drinks are on Bulwark tonight!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Five tours. Not one ship, not one squad lost. The whole fleet salutes you, pilot.

lines.speaker: nomad
lines.text: Thirty years flying, and this is the run I'll tell stories about.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Every wing, every crew, every squad. Fleet intact. Legendary.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Not a scratch on the whole fleet! You're unbelievable!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite to air wing. Every trooper down here is cheering for you.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern here. All lights on, all teams home. Thank you, pilot!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Carrier contact! Break its shield, then hit the hatch!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Here comes the big one. Shield first, then the core.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Oh, that's huge. That is really, really huge.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Carrier field is up. Wear it down before the hatch opens.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Carrier in range. All fleet guns, support the pilot.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: It's changing form. Stay on the hatch.

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Carrier's adapting. New pattern.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Field's down! Hit the core!

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: It's getting angry. Good. Keep going.

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: New form. Same weak spot. Find the hatch.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The Carrier is down! All ships, the fleet salutes you.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: It's falling! It's actually falling!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Target destroyed. Hell of a run, pilot.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Carrier down! Woohoo!

lines.speaker: sunny
lines.text: Carrier down! Looks like it's lights out for them.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: All ships totalled, but every pilot is safe. Regroup at base. We go again.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: That's the last reserve. Bring it home, pilot. We'll launch again.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Recovery has your pod. Rest up. The fleet will be ready when you are.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Ground enemies incoming! Ground forces ahead!

lines.speaker: wisp
lines.text: Demon ground troops below. Marking them now.

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: Movement on the ground. Brood infantry.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Bulwark here. Brood walkers moving on our line!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion to air wing. Enemy armor on the ground, your side of the ridge.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite here. They're massing below you. Lots of them.

lines.speaker: sparrow
lines.text: Ground targets in range. Fire!

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Strafing run! Hit them now!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: They're under your guns. Take the shot.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern here. They're right under you. Light them up!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: You're right over them. Bring the rain!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: We're pinned down. Need air support!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Please shoot these enemies! They're all over us!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Pick up some homing missiles! We need them off our backs!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion to air wing, my teams are taking fire. Requesting support!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's surrounded! Anything you've got, send it down!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern to air wing, we're taking fire! Help!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: That did it! Thanks for the cover, flyer!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: They're scattering! We owe you one!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Pressure's off. Bastion thanks you, air wing.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's clear! Solid as a rock, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern is clear. Beautiful shooting!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: I'm totalled! Going back to base!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern's rig is totalled. We're limping home. Cover the gap!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion's command track is wrecked. Pulling back to base. Hold the line for us!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's crumbled! Heading back to base to patch up!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: A ground team is heading home for repairs. Cover their retreat.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: Bulwark here. Splashed a walker. Line's holding.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern got one! Scratch one brood crawler.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion reports another contact down. This sector is ours.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite here. One less demon on the ground.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Ground crews are crushing it down there!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: They're pushing harder. Could use some help soon.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: More of them every minute down here. Keep an eye on us.

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Bastion to air wing. Pressure is building on our line.

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's starting to crack. Not yet, but soon.

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: We can't hold much longer! Need air support now!

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: Lantern's line is buckling! Help us!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: All air units, the ground line is about to break!

lines.speaker: mensah
lines.text: Granite's crumbling fast! Send everything you've got!

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: The ground line is failing. Give them cover, pilot.

lines.speaker: admiral
lines.text: Breakthrough! Enemy ground units in firing range!

lines.speaker: kessler
lines.text: They broke through! Missiles coming your way!

lines.speaker: march
lines.text: Breach in the line! They're targeting the air wing!

lines.speaker: kestrel
lines.text: Ground breakthrough. Watch for missiles from below!

lines.speaker: anvil
lines.text: They're through the line. Dodge the ground fire!
